title: Create the Oficina Vibra GitHub account
notes: GitHub's bot check (DataDome, 'El acceso está restringido temporalmente') blocks the signup from Orca's automated browser, 2026-11-22, so a person must do it. Sign up at https://github.com/signup with oficina@tieneslavibra.com and the password in 1Password, vault Vibra, item 'GitHub Oficina Vibra' (add the username there). The verification code arrives at oficina@tieneslavibra.com (Vexa reads it). Then an agent signs in from the Orca profile github-deluxe-producciones, or a new one.
The Orca profile made for the attempt was removed; use a fresh isolated profile.
done_when: The account exists, its username is in the 1Password item, and it can sign in
